initiative.summary: Linked objects look and act like links in SVG and the viewer; named emphasis states in the .draft file draw one diagram several ways without moving anything.

claims.statement: Linked objects should be interactive in SVG and the viewer, with a fitting visual cue.
Agents need a way to define links and emphasis that does not get out of control.
Named states emphasize some objects and de-emphasize others, as a user-defined styling layer like the diff view.

claims.notes: Byron 'doesn't fully buy into' it; question 4 checks how far stepping goes.

claims.statement: Views of several states or diagrams: single, small multiples, grid or overlays.
claims.notes: Many states of one file are in scope; multi-file boards and overlays are below the cut line.

claims.statement: States never move anything; all states share one geometry.
Respect the agent's href: URLs open as written, .draft in the viewer, file paths in the editor.
Relative hrefs resolve from the git root of the .draft; a config line overrides the base.
Settings live in a clearly named `config key=value` statement; several keys per line or one per line; duplicate keys warn and the last wins.
check warns on missing files and suggests a likely path; the link is never rewritten silently. Line anchors use path:42.
Viewer links come first and get the careful resolution; static SVG takes a decent first guess.
Links show a corner arrow mark; the editor is VS Code by default, configurable in the file.
A state fades unlisted objects with the context look; rest=plain gives a soft highlight.
States step in file order; inspect --svg draws plain; --states draws only the states; state chips sit top-center.
Multi-file views wait until states of one file ship.

shape.appetite: Six small PRs; no new renderer, no layout change, no walkthrough.
shape.problem: Links are invisible and the viewer cannot open them; one diagram cannot show several emphases.
shape.recommended_shape: Viewer links with a corner mark, git-root resolution, editor deep links at path:line and a `config` line; check suggestions; static SVG links as a first guess; `state id "label" ids… rest=dim|plain` painted through the status layer; --state, --states panels, and top-center state chips.

dsl_options.name: tags on objects + state by tag

success_moves: Reuse statusPaint/statusSwatch/drawnSwatch with two new treatments instead of a second renderer.
Generalize the compare panel code to N panels; states share one routing pass.
Ship links before states; href already reaches the model.
Keep the active state as view state (URL param), never written to the file.
Prove identical canonicalGeometry across states before any viewer work.

rabbit_holes: Overlays of several states in one drawing
